scenarios.name: Complete a model turn through governed platform in worker posture
Interrupt worker and relaunch with clean owned configuration and successful model execution

root_cause: Previous stale platform authentication resolved by owner sign-in; worker model execution succeeds. No source or test changes required.
notes: Control reports cancellation unconfirmed; plugin independently confirms execution-interrupted. Ancestor 1.x primary plugins show nonfatal activation warnings in nested disposable fixture. Worker plugin records lifecycle successfully. Credentials unchanged; no broad tests or other pipeline phases run.
